messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Hosted runtime node pool gpupool-7 reported multiple KV cache OOMs across replicas (OOM count: 5 in 2m). Suspected runaway context windows / long prompts causing continuous batching amplification. Auto-mitigation triggered: prefetch throttle -> partial, canary rollback queued.
anya: acked. oncall switching in.
sam: joining — seeing increased evictions and batch sizes spiking in the metrics graph.
matt: passing logs from gpupool-7: `out_of_memory: attempted alloc 1.2GiB for KV page` repeated.
elaine: customer-facing: CSMs flagged 3 paying customers with increased 5xx rates. Lindsey, can you confirm impacted tenants?
csm-lindsey: two tenants (acme-inc, writeflow) saw 5xx spikes starting ~6932104200. Escalated to priority.
oncall: I’m the active pager, handing off to infra-lead for kernel-level fixes.
infra-lead: on it. First step: disable continuous prefetching for gpupool-7 and reduce max batch window to 64 tokens. Pushing config now.
sam: before toggle, can we fast-evict largest KV entries for sessions > 30k tokens? I have a script ready.
anya: do it, but coordinate with infra so we don't thrash.
matt: applying quick eviction: `./tools/kvctl evict --pool gpupool-7 --max-age 1800 --min-size 1M`
incident-bot: ACTION: eviction job started (job_id: evict-69321). Estimated 40s.
support-bot: Noted customer incidents: create incident tickets for acme-inc and writeflow, add postmortem label.
elaine: I’ve messaged both CSMs with note that we’re throttling prefetch and performing eviction; offering status updates.
infra-lead: pushing batch config hotfix now: set continuous_batch_window = 64 -> 32 for gpupool-7; disable prefix prefetch. Rolling to 2/3 nodes first.
oncall: reduce canary size to 1 node if risk is high.
infra-lead: canary applied to node-3. Monitoring logs.
matt: node-3 logs show steady batch size reduction to median 28 tokens. No new OOMs in last 30s.
sam: good signal. Start rolling to remainder with 30s stagger.
incident-bot: NOTE: fallback model routing engaged for heavy sessions — requests above 80k tokens are routed to dedicated-reserved clusters to avoid further memory pressure.
anya: task for follow-up: add a circuit-breaker to reject requests > 100k tokens on hosted by default.
elaine: agreed. Also need customer comms draft for impacted tenants.
csm-lindsey: drafting now. ETA 10m.
oncall: rolling complete. No new OOM alerts for 5m.
infra-lead: starting post-eviction KV stability check: `kvstats --pool gpupool-7 --window 10m` results look healthy, active KV count down 42%.
matt: collecting traces for continuous-batching path to find amplification loop. Suspect session prefix growth + batching TTL mismatch.
sam: rough root cause hypothesis: very long user prompts (>>100k tokens) keep KV alive, prefetch expands window and continuous batching groups partial prefixes -> repeated duplication of KV references and memory blowup.
anya: mitigation summary to include in postmortem: 1) emergency throttle on prefetch 2) batch window hard cap 3) eviction job 4) routing heavy sessions to dedicated clusters 5) circuit-breaker on extreme contexts.
elaine: customer comms to go out after we confirm stability for 15m.
incident-bot: METRIC: 5xx rate for acme-inc back to baseline. writeflow still 2x — small retry storm, looking into it.
matt: writeflow issue due to client retries — lowering retry TTL on routing layer fixed that.
oncall: handing off to oncall for next 6 hours: anya, you are primary; sam backup. Please monitor gpupool-7 and metrics dashboard.
anya: accepted handoff. Will run targeted load tests to validate.
incident-bot: REMINDER: create retrospective notes and assign actions: `postmortem/6932104321-kv-oom-hosted` in docs.
elaine: I’ll coordinate the customer update and attach monitoring screenshots.
csm-lindsey: sent comms to both customers; they acknowledge and requested a follow-up call tomorrow.
infra-lead: long-term actions I’ll add to ticket: enforce max session length on hosted, improve KV GC heuristics, add prefetch backpressure signal, and expand canary rollout steps for batch config.
matt: also propose adding simulated long-prompt tests to CI. Found reproduction case at ~1.1M tokens that triggers the path.
anya: thanks team — closing live mitigation. Keep channel open for 1h for any regressions. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: status -> mitigated (confidence: high).
